title: 2021 Topps Star Wars Battle Of Hoth Tow Cables Take Down an AT-AT Walker #74
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The 2021 Topps Star Wars Battle Of Hoth Tow Cables Take Down an AT-AT Walker #74 trading card is part of the Topps Star Wars Battle Plans set. This original card features the character Tow Cables Take Down an AT-AT Walker, manufactured by Topps in 2021. Measuring 3½" x 2½", this card is a must-have for fans of the Star Wars franchise and collectors of unique trading cards.
